title: Ethics and Impact of AI
text:
Every request to a large language model uses roughly ten times the energy of a typical web search — modest per query, significant at scale, worth using intentionally rather than by default.

Student work belongs to students under Quebec's Law 25, which is exactly why free AI tools can never be used to grade or comment on it without informed consent — anonymizing a text doesn't change whose work it is.

And because AI can produce in seconds what takes a student hours, the real risk is cognitive: the difficulty AI skips past is often the same difficulty that builds the skill.
